description: The documents in a US mark's file, newest first: each one's date, type code and description (an office action, a specimen, a registration certificate), whether it came in or went out, and its pages, from USPTO's TSDR. download_mark_documents saves the ones picked by type and date.

id.description: The USPTO serial number (8 digits), as search_marks lists it.

office.description: US: case files come from USPTO's TSDR; other offices say where to read them.

name: mark_documents

category.description: incoming (filed with the office) or outgoing (sent by it)

type.description: The office's type code; download_mark_documents filters on it

title: A mark's documents
